AFFORDABILITY AND OUR MISSION Our Mission Patio Escapes offers premium custom screening systems to transform your existing covered patio into a comfortable, protected Escape. 🌿 Patio Escapes Promise and Mission is simple: To deliver high-quality screened patio enclosures that are not only luxuriously beautiful and functional , as well as, added privacy and protection. Affordability is our main goal and execution of your vision. Initial Consultation Planning and Design Initial consultation after your pictures are sent to discuss your vision, size, shape, and intended use of the patio Site assessment to evaluate sunlight exposure, existing landscape features, and drainage patterns Design layout and added customizations (see options below) Experience the Craftsmanship: A FULL Gallery of Patio Escapes's Projects Customer Testimonials: Our Work Speaks for Itself Standard installation: (most common) Floor to ceiling framing and screen with one self closing door Optional Knee Wall (ask for cost): 12"-48" Tall privacy wall built with painted siding and trim Optional X Bar (ask for Cost): gives that southern and modern feel and look to your patio Optional French Door ($250): an additional door added for entertaining purposes Optional Crossbar/Picture Frame (ask for cost): for an additional aesthetic look Enclosure Timeline Site Preparation Remove all hanging lights, decor, and debris. Move all patio items to the middle of the patio. Reschedule landscapers, move all plants and pots. Frame/Base Installation Hand painted exterior protective coated wood framing, to provide a solid foundation and easy to clean structure. Screen Installation Screen material selected is applied to the wooded frame and then trimmed with pre painted color selected wood. Door Installation Door(s) pre painted, include door handles, lock,door pump closure. During consultation it will be established if you would like Double Doors, Dog/cat Door, additional doors. *custom fees apply Finishing Touches/Cleaning and Inspection Clean the work area and patio surface and inspect for any defects.
